This commit adds features for managing **franchise bills and inventory**. It lets franchises view and manage their bills (incoming and outgoing), create new bills with options to report problems, and manage their own inventory. It also automatically populates new franchise inventories and adds new products to all relevant franchise inventories. Additionally, there are improvements to API responses, error handling, and database relationships for better data management.
